_note: The campaign's numbers (Game Design's docs/design/campaign.md; sim/core/campaign.gd; docs/architecture/campaign-core.md). Campaign-only: no versus match reads this file, and no fighter reads anything of the campaign (Legal mc01, mc06).
_enabled: the one switch: the campaign's host builds episodes, columns and the season record only while it is on
_columns: an episode's stages, each a column of the route: the cold open, the rise, the twist, the escalation and the climax (campaign.md 2.2)
_placesPerColumn: the places a column offers, chosen by flying (campaign.md 2.2); the climax is the opponent's home ground, one place
_crossBack: a place not taken in column `from` can come back in column `to` as a consequence (campaign.md 2.2: the rise's untaken place returns at the escalation)
_sideShare: thousandths: a main-story episode won offers a side story on about this share of them (campaign.md 1.4: about half, a first value)
_arcEpisodes: a filler arc's episodes: the pilot, the middle and the finale (campaign.md 2.1)
_families: Narrative's filler families (docs/narrative/filler-templates.md filler_kind): a filler arc's first two episodes take two different ones by the arc's seed
_stageCols: a stage's stand-in ring round its place (Close), until World's ring turn puts a column's places along the ring the players fly
